title: Anthropic’s Record IPO Highlights The Economics Of Frontier AI
title_zh: Anthropic 創紀錄的 IPO，凸顯前沿 AI 的經濟邏輯
subtitle: Anthropic 創紀錄的 IPO，凸顯前沿 AI 的經濟邏輯
author: Karim Mattar, Tasha Keeney, Brett Winton

sentences.en: Last week, Anthropic began trading on Nasdaq after pricing its initial public offering (IPO) at $83 per share, above the initial $70–$78 range indicated.
sentences.zh: 上週，Anthropic 將首次公開發行定價為每股 83 美元，高於原先指出的 70 到 78 美元區間，並開始在那斯達克交易。

sentences.en: The offering generated $93.5 billion in gross proceeds, surpassing SpaceX’s $85.7 billion IPO and valuing it at ~$1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
sentences.zh: 這次發行募得 935 億美元的總金額，超過 SpaceX 857 億美元的 IPO，並以完全稀釋計算，把公司估值定在約 1.5 兆美元。

sentences.en: During the third quarter, revenue hit $17 billion, up more than 12x on a year-over-year basis and 47% sequentially.
sentences.zh: 第三季營收達到 170 億美元，較去年同期增加 12 倍以上，較上一季增加 47%。

sentences.en: Shorter term, the company’s ARR (annualized revenue run rate) rose from ~$71 billion at the end of September to $81 billion at the end of October.
sentences.zh: 就較短期來看，公司的年化經常性營收（ARR）從 9 月底約 710 億美元，升至 10 月底的 810 億美元。

sentences.en: During the third quarter, Anthropic reached $70.7 billion in remaining long-term commitments—an amount meriting increased attention, given the company’s cash generation (or lack thereof) and stated need for further investment.
sentences.zh: 第三季，Anthropic 剩餘的長期承諾應付達到 707 億美元——考量公司現金創造能力（或不足）以及它表明還需要進一步投資，這個數字值得多加關注。

sentences.en: Last Friday, I stood at Starbase and watched Starship lift off on its 15th test flight.
sentences.zh: 上週五，我站在 Starbase，看著星艦進行第 15 次試飛升空。

sentences.en: After deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites and circling the earth ~14 times over ~22 hours, the ship flew back to Starbase and settled into the launch tower's “chopstick” arms.
sentences.zh: 在部署 26 顆星鏈 V3 衛星，並在約 22 小時內繞地球約 14 圈之後，船體飛回 Starbase，落入發射塔的「筷子」手臂中。

sentences.en: Full and rapid rocket reuse should allow launch costs to decline dramatically from today’s levels of slightly under $1,000 per kilogram to $100 during the next five years.
sentences.zh: 若火箭能完全且快速重複使用，發射成本應會從目前略低於每公斤 1,000 美元，在未來五年大幅降到 100 美元。

sentences.en: At ~$300 per kilogram, ARK estimates that orbital data center costs will fall below their terrestrial counterparts.
sentences.zh: ARK 估計，當成本約為每公斤 300 美元時，軌道資料中心的成本將低於地面資料中心。

sentences.en: Ironically, as Anthropic went public last week, technology stocks suffered their worst drawdown since the dotcom bust more than 25 years ago.
sentences.zh: 諷刺的是，就在 Anthropic 上週掛牌的同時，科技股出現了逾 25 年前網路泡沫破裂以來最深的跌幅。

vocab.usage: price an initial public offering 為 IPO 定價；也可簡稱 IPO
vocab.example: The company delayed its initial public offering until next year.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司把首次公開發行延到明年。

vocab.usage: 常用複數；gross proceeds 總募資額；the proceeds of a sale 出售所得
vocab.example: The proceeds from the sale will be used to pay down debt.
vocab.example_zh: 這次出售的所得將用來償還債務。

vocab.usage: surpass a previous record / IPO 超過先前紀錄／上市規模
vocab.example: This year’s sales have already surpassed the annual target.
vocab.example_zh: 今年的銷售已經超過年度目標。

vocab.usage: on a fully diluted basis 以完全稀釋計算；fully diluted shares 完全稀釋後的股數
vocab.example: The company was valued at $10 billion on a fully diluted basis.
vocab.example_zh: 以完全稀釋計算，這家公司估值為 100 億美元。

vocab.usage: 常寫成 year-over-year 或 YoY；也可當形容詞 a year-over-year increase
vocab.example: Revenue rose 12% year-over-year in the third quarter.
vocab.example_zh: 第三季營收較去年同期成長 12%。

vocab.usage: grew 47% sequentially 較上一季成長 47%；常對照 year-over-year
vocab.example: Orders increased sequentially for the third month.
vocab.example_zh: 訂單連續第三個月較前一個月增加。

vocab.usage: annualized revenue run rate 年化經常性營收；annualized return 年化報酬
vocab.example: The fund posted an annualized return of 8%.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔基金的年化報酬是 8%。

vocab.zh: 年化速度；推估的全年規模
vocab.usage: revenue run rate 年化營收速度；ARR = annualized revenue run rate
vocab.example: The startup now has a $50 million annual run rate.
vocab.example_zh: 這家新創目前的年化營收速度是 5,000 萬美元。

vocab.usage: long-term commitments 長期承諾／應付義務；make a commitment 做出承諾
vocab.example: The firm has large long-term commitments to suppliers.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司對供應商有大筆長期承諾。

vocab.usage: watch a rocket lift off 看火箭升空；名詞 liftoff 是「升空」
vocab.example: The rocket is scheduled to lift off at dawn.
vocab.example_zh: 火箭預定在黎明時升空。

vocab.usage: deploy satellites 部署衛星；deploy resources 調度資源
vocab.example: The company plans to deploy the new system next month.
vocab.example_zh: 公司計畫下個月部署這套新系統。

vocab.usage: rocket reuse 火箭重複使用；動詞 reuse 也可當「再次使用」
vocab.example: Faster reuse could bring down launch costs.
vocab.example_zh: 更快的重複使用可能降低發射成本。

vocab.usage: decline dramatically 大幅下降；change dramatically 急劇改變
vocab.example: Prices fell dramatically after the announcement.
vocab.example_zh: 宣布之後，價格大幅下跌。

vocab.usage: terrestrial counterparts 地面的對應物；terrestrial TV 地面電視（對照衛星）
vocab.example: Orbital costs may fall below terrestrial ones.
vocab.example_zh: 軌道上的成本可能低於地面。

vocab.usage: ironically, as… 諷刺的是，正當…之際
vocab.example: Ironically, the warning came too late to help.
vocab.example_zh: 諷刺的是，這項警告來得太晚，已經幫不上忙。

vocab.usage: the worst drawdown 最深的回撤；a 20% drawdown 回撤 20%
vocab.example: The fund suffered a sharp drawdown last year.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔基金去年出現大幅回撤。

vocab.usage: have trouble justifying 很難為…提出合理說明；justify the cost 證明成本合理
vocab.example: It is hard to justify such a large investment right now.
vocab.example_zh: 現在很難為這麼大筆投資提出合理說明。

vocab.usage: the magnitude of the investment / build-out 這筆投資／擴建的規模
vocab.example: Few people expected a correction of this magnitude.
vocab.example_zh: 很少人預料到會有這麼大幅度的修正。

vocab.usage: the sell-off is not supported by… 這波拋售並沒有…支持；a market sell-off 市場拋售
vocab.example: The sell-off wiped out the week’s gains.
vocab.example_zh: 這波拋售抹掉了本週的漲幅。

vocab.usage: a halving in the price 價格減半；動詞 halve 是「使減半」
vocab.example: A halving in costs could attract more users.
vocab.example_zh: 成本減半可能吸引更多使用者。
